newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring up on MGE gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring up on MGE gains.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat cash bids were firm on Monday, in line with gains in MGE wheat, and several brokers noted good mill demand for high protein wheat.
"There seems to be a real big push for 14 or 15 percent high protein," a Minnesota dealer said.
While much of the new crop grain was harvested with high protein levels, slow farmer selling forced end-users to bid up for the supplies, a Montana dealer said.
"They've got some pretty good bids out there but they're not getting much (response) on them," he said. The farmers "are waiting for more."

In other markets, movement was slow as farmers continued to hold out for higher prices, a dealer said. A North Dakota dealer noted MGE spring wheat futures were trading at a discount to CBOT and KCBT futures.
"I expect we'll see some sort of rebound here," he said. "The cash market seems tight. Farmers don't want to sell. I can't see how we can stay down in the doldrums like this."
